title: SAPMS: Added SAP MS as main dissector
description:
Added the SAP MS (Message Server) dissector protocol from [SecureAuth's plugin](https://github.com/SecureAuthCorp/SAP-Dissection-plug-in-for-Wireshark/blob/master/src/packet-sapms.c).

This is a dissector that partially implements the MS protocol. Some details and example requests can be found in [pysap's documentation](https://pysap.readthedocs.io/en/latest/protocols/SAPMS.html).
